scientific_integrity: The complete proof, exact algebraic balances, small-amplitude existence argument, and conditional scope are stated. The bundled standalone numerical checker is corroboration only. No independent scientific validation or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact defect identity is conditional on strictly positive periodic coexistence solutions and assumes no switching-threshold crossings.
Small-sinusoid uniqueness and asymptotic expansion are local to the unforced coexistence equilibrium at each fixed positive frequency.
The unique optimum is for the quadratic weak-forcing predator-mean coefficient, not an asserted exact finite-amplitude optimum.
The 2013 Taylor–Sherratt–White primary full text was inaccessible; priority is not independently established.
title: Exact predator-mean deficit and universal weak-forcing resonance in a threshold predator–prey system
